name: Gemini web
description: Turns your gemini.google.com subscription quota into a model service: the plugin runs a local reverse proxy (replays the web app's API, rotates across accounts, refreshes cookies) and adds it to the model lists of the agents you pick (Claude, dimensio). Personal use only.

agents.label: Available to
agents.desc: Checked agents get a “Gemini web” service in their model list. Unchecked ones don’t (the proxy keeps running).

members.label: Members can use it too
members.desc: On a multi-user server, members’ Claude / dimensio can pick these models as well (on your Google account’s quota).

models.label: Models to list
models.desc: None checked = list everything the accounts can use. The list comes from the accounts (test an account to refresh it).

defaultModel.label: Default model
defaultModel.desc: Empty = the first one. gemini-argon (4 Argon) or gemini-pro recommended.

deepThinking.label: Deep thinking by default
deepThinking.desc: Makes the “Deep thinking” effort the default (slower, stronger). You can still switch per conversation.

mode.label: Proxy
mode.desc: “Started by bridge” = the plugin starts the proxy and restarts it if it crashes (recommended). “Already running” = connect to a Gemini Proxy you run separately.

python.label: Python
python.desc: Command or path for Python 3.10+ (python, py -3, C:\Python312\python.exe). On first start it creates a virtual environment in the plugin’s data folder and installs dependencies (about a minute, needs PyPI); not used after that.

port.label: Port
port.desc: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Pick another if something else is using it.

apiKey.label: Proxy API key
apiKey.desc: Only if your proxy has an API key set. When bridge starts the proxy, the plugin generates one itself.

proxy.label: Proxy for reaching Google
proxy.desc: Needed in mainland China, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:7890. Empty = use bridge’s own outbound proxy (follows it when it changes); direct if bridge is direct. pip uses it too.
